caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate teapot positioned centrally against a plain, light-colored background. The teapot is rendered in grayscale, with shading to indicate its metallic surface and rounded form. It features a large, bulbous body with a slightly flared base and a domed lid topped with a finial. The handle, situated on the left side, is large, curving outward in an elegant arc, and is shaded more darkly to suggest a different material or color, possibly wood or ebony. The spout on the right side is elongated and stylized, with decorative elements and a flared tip. At the center of the teapot’s body, there is a single, ornate letter "B" engraved or inscribed. The overall composition is symmetrical, and there are no additional objects or patterns in the background. The artist’s signature is located at the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Silver Teapot
